fusions.name: Weighted Cast
fusions.desc: Throws a weighted mesh that deals 14 damage and stuns the target for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawstring Sweep
fusions.desc: Closes a ring around you that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Gathering Line
fusions.desc: Draws a wall 6.5 tiles long across the water for 6 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Catch Feeds
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition on an enemy, you recover 5 stamina.
